description: Update a scheduled job's cron expression or timezone without redeploying. At least one of schedule or timezone must be provided. Schedule uses standard 5-field cron syntax (minute hour day month weekday). Timezone is IANA format (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Returns the effective schedule and timezone after update.

job.description: The App's scheduled job, by its name (telbase jobs list).

schedule.description: The cron expression (e.g. '0 * * * *' hourly, '0 9 * * *' 9am daily). Pass the current one to change only the timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the schedule (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Default UTC.

name: update_schedule
